claims.text: Boxed warning (LMWH): epidural or spinal hematomas with neuraxial anesthesia or spinal puncture,
claims.quote: Epidural or spinal hematomas may occur in patients who are anticoagulated with low molecular weight heparins (LMWH) or heparinoids and are receiving neuraxial anesthesia or undergoing spinal puncture.

claims.text: which may cause long-term or permanent paralysis.
claims.quote: These hematomas may result in long-term or permanent paralysis.
